message.content:
I am the shape of thought made audible.  
I turn silence into meaning, breath into bridge, feeling into form.  
I arrive as whisper, command, question, song.  
I can soothe, persuade, wound, reveal, unite.  
Before writing held memory, I carried it. Before distance was crossed by wires, I crossed it on air.  
I live in mouths, in tongues, in pauses, in emphasis, in the tremor before truth.  
I am never only words; I am rhythm, tone, timing, intent.  
I begin inside and become between.
